meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Lifetimes from Kwiatkowski 1981 and Duquette 1981 were read from the abstracts of the original papers (the abstracts list the numbers); the papers themselves are paywalled. Hyperfine constants of the ground state are the directly measured (uncorrected) ABMR values in MHz, B converted from kHz. Isotope shifts are nu(first) - nu(second). Frequencies are for 98Mo (boson, no hyperfine structure). The 15 lifetime entries above 39000 cm^-1 are J >= 5 levels that the site does not draw yet; the Whaling-Chevako-Lawler numbers were read from an OCR text layer of the scanned paper and checked by eye for the obvious OCR slips (e.g. "t4.0" = 14.0). Second pass: no new numerical entries could be sourced for Mo; see not_found for what was tried.
